discussion.body: Act 9. Open world chapter: temple circuit. Visit any of the six temples in any order. Rebound a cracked Sigil or leave it cracked (that only changes Act 13 fight texture). Side: deeper optional floors, aspect-spirits, pilgrim quests, Light beacon repair, Life blight farms, Water storm lanes, Earth rail-temple, Fire mouth camps, Mist wreck-isle if Bengenia was wiped. This is where 'a lot of side content' lives around FEAT-003 / FEAT-021-026. Not on rails.
